kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the facts; the pattern/trap/pivot attack structure is a KYP design that does not exist in the source.
kypExtensions.summary: KYP-authored exam-strategy synthesis (image-pattern vignettes, Marfan-vs-homocystinuria traps, tall-patient and child-abuse pivots, Marfan mini-case with answer autopsy) built on the cited First Aid pages.

The molecule-first organization of the disease cluster (type I collagen = OI; type V/III = EDS classical/vascular; copper-lysyl oxidase = Menkes; fibrillin-1 + TGF-β = Marfan; elastin dosage = Williams) and the OI-vs-child-abuse differential framing with its stakes.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid lists the diseases sequentially; sorting them by matrix molecule so the phenotype predicts the gene (and reverse) is KYP pedagogy, as is the explicit abuse-differential guidance.
